maddeler.e: غَافِث or غَافَث • (ḡāfiṯ or ḡāfaṯ) m
maddeler.t: The عَالَم (ʕālam)-like non-Arabic pattern and the presence of begedkefet show that this is from Classical Syriac ܐܓܐܦܬ (/⁠*ʾaḡāp̄əṯ⁠/), compare a similar pattern in the Syriac etymon of أَبَق (ʔabaq, “Mannila hemp”) and فَاشِر (fāšir, “bryony”) for a similar degree of corruption.
g: agrimony (Agrimonia gen. et spp.), especially the common agrimony (Agrimonia eupatoria)
